name: rosetta-count-in-factors
code:
use default

factors(n: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] is
    let remaining mut = n
    let divisor mut = 2

    while divisor * divisor <= remaining do
        while remaining % divisor == 0 do
            yield divisor
            remaining = remaining / divisor
        od

        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    if remaining > 1 then
        yield remaining
    fi
si

describe(n: int) -> string =>
    if n == 1 then "1" else factors(n) |> map(f => "{f}") |> join(" x ") fi

for n in 1::25 do
    write_line("{n}: {describe(n)}")
od

write_line("{2144}: {describe(2144)}")
